Name: New Outfit for Emily
Author: doubledashell
Description:
[u][b][size=5]New Outfit for Emily[/size][/b][/u]
For Stardew Valley 1.5 and Content Patcher

I never liked Emily's vanilla sprite. It bugged me that she looked like she was wearing some type of gown when in her portrait she's clearly wearing a button up shirt. So, I made a new one with a better matching shirt and a cute skirt to go with. I also edited her hair a bit to flare out at the ends more like in her portrait as well(includes beach sprites with just the hair changes).


Instructions:
-Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
-Unzip files into mod folder
-Run game with SMAPI
